name: DevFest
tagline: A 2-day celebration of technology, AI agents, mobile, cloud, and open source with your local community.
description: DevFest Your City 2026 brings together developers, designers, researchers, and tech enthusiasts for two packed days of keynotes, hands-on workshops, technical deep-dives, and networking across four specialized tracks.

venueDetails.address: Community Hub, 100 Innovation Way, Your City
venueDetails.transit: Accessible via city bus routes 3 & 7 and local ride-hail services. Free parking on site.
venueDetails.accessibility: Wheelchair accessible entrances, ramps, gender-neutral restrooms, and reserved seating available in all halls.
